claims.object_text: abundant expression in the developing brain
claims.quote: Solute carrier family 6 member 1 (SLC6A1) is abundantly expressed in the developing brain even before the CNS is formed.

claims.object_text: reuptake of GABA into presynaptic neurons and glia; modulation of neurotransmission
claims.quote: Its encoded GABA transporter 1 (GAT-1) is responsible for the reuptake of GABA into presynaptic neurons and glia, thereby modulating neurotransmission.

claims.object_text: expression in both astrocytes and neurons throughout the brain
claims.quote: GAT-1 is expressed globally in the brain, in both astrocytes and neurons.

claims.object_text: neuronal GABA uptake non-compensable; glial function partially replaceable by GABA transporter 3
claims.quote: The GABA uptake function of GAT-1 in neurons cannot be compensated for by other GABA transporters, while the function in glia can be partially replaced by GABA transporter 3.

claims.object_text: spectrum of epilepsy syndromes and neurodevelopmental disorders, including myoclonic atonic epilepsy, childhood absence epilepsy, autism, and intellectual disability
claims.quote: Recently, many variants in SLC6A1 have been associated with a spectrum of epilepsy syndromes and neurodevelopmental disorders, including myoclonic atonic epilepsy, childhood absence epilepsy, autism, and intellectual disability,
We found that a partial or complete loss-of-function represents a common disease mechanism, although the extent of GABA uptake reduction is variable.

claims.object_text: reduced cell surface expression caused by protein misfolding, ER retention, and degradation
claims.quote: The reduced GABA uptake appears to be due to reduced cell surface expression of the variant transporter caused by variant protein misfolding, endoplasmic reticulum retention, and subsequent degradation.

claims.object_text: neurons and astrocytes derived from human patient induced pluripotent stem cells
claims.quote: neurons and astrocytes derived from human patient induced pluripotent stem cells

claims.object_text: consistent loss of GABA uptake function and ER retention across iPSC-derived cell types
claims.quote: the loss of GABA uptake function and endoplasmic reticulum retention is consistent across induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cell types, including astrocytes and neurons, for the surveyed variants.

claims.object_text: impaired transporter protein trafficking and surface expression are major disease-associated mechanisms
claims.quote: Together, our study suggests that impaired transporter protein trafficking and surface expression are the major disease-associated mechanisms associated with pathogenic SLC6A1 variants.

claims.object_text: boosting transporter function by genetic or pharmacological approaches
claims.quote: boosting transporter function by either genetic or pharmacological approaches would be beneficial.
